page.overview:
Who is Bunny Link?

Bunny Link is a form of Link in , appearing as a fluffy anthropomorphic pink rabbit wearing a green tunic. Link is transformed into this shape as a result of entering the Dark World, the corrupted version of the Sacred Realm by Ganon's heart, which changes people to reflect their true nature.

As a bunny, unlike other transformations seen in later games (primarily ), although cute-looking, Link is completely defenseless and cannot use any of his weapons or his Shield. He can also not lift pots. However, he can still collect items. Therefore, he must avoid enemies and other hazards. The young hero can retain his original Hylian form after obtaining the Moon Pearl from the Tower of Hera, the third and final dungeon of the Light World (Hyrule).

When Link climbs Death Mountain on his quest to find the three Pendants of Virtue, he finds a portal in the north-east side of the mountain that teleports him to the Dark World's counterpart. Without the Moon Pearl, Link finds himself transformed into Bunny Link. A Bully and his friend nearby explains to him how the world transforms anyone who enters in reflection of their true nature. Once Link obtains the Moon Pearl from the Tower of Hera, he will no longer transform into Bunny Link whenever he enters the Dark World.

In certain Dark World dungeons, Link can temporarily be re-transformed into a rabbit regardless if he has the Moon Pearl by coming in contact with rotating, golden star-shaped objects called Rabbit Beams. However, this change wears off after five seconds or after being hit by an enemy.
